_comment: Copy to ~/.stonedog-ask/copilot.json. Every key is optional.
_copilotArgs: Replaces the built-in base args wholesale. Set this if a flag name below turns out to be wrong on your Copilot version — the fix should be one line of JSON, not a patch to the script. Verify against `copilot --help` at install time.
_allowTools: Tools the agent may use unattended. Reading mail to summarise it needs the relevant MCP tools named here. Leaving this empty is safe and useless; --allow-all-tools is useful and includes shell execution. Name what you need.
_requireSources: MCP server names that must be configured, or the run refuses. A brief missing a source looks exactly like a quiet day, which is the failure this prevents.
_cwd: Directory to run in. Copilot is agentic and takes its bearings from cwd. Defaults to the journal dir, which is deliberately boring.
_extraArgs: Anything else passed through to copilot.
